jobs.description:
Are you a software or computer science student who wants to apply what you learn to real projects in an industry moving full speed ahead with digitalisation? Do you want to work on the tools that help us run a more efficient and greener fleet? If you have an interest in maritime shipping and want to be part of its transformation, we’d love to hear from you!

What you will do...

As our new Student Assistant working out of our Copenhagen office, you will join the Fleet Efficiency & Decarbonisation team. You will help build and maintain the team’s internal data and web applications: Python back-end, PostgreSQL database, web front-end and automated tests, AI assistants, deployed on Microsoft Azure. Your tasks are matched to your experience and your study schedule.

Among other interesting tasks, you will:

• Develop, test, and maintain internal tools and applications that support fleet performance and decarbonisation

• Build and improve back-end services and REST APIs in Python

• Write SQL queries, database migrations and data checks in PostgreSQL

• Improve the web front-end and the user experience

• Ensure code quality, maintainability, and portability

• Collaborate closely with domain experts and fellow developers

We offer a flexible working week of 2-3 days, with more hours required during holiday periods and fewer hours during your exam periods.

We’re looking for a team player who…

• Has a strong sense of ownership and responsibility

• Thrives in a collaborative environment but works independently with confidence

• Embraces constructive feedback and continuously seeks growth as a developer

• Communicates ideas clearly and effectively

• Understands user needs and perspectives

We furthermore expect that you…

• Are enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s programme in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, with at least one year of studies left

• Have solid programming skills in Python

• Have working knowledge of SQL and relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MSSQL)

• Are familiar with web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and REST APIs

• Have experience with version control (Git) and a collaborative workflow

• Ideally, but not necessarily, have worked with a Python web framework (e.g. FastAPI, Django), Docker, or a cloud platform (e.g. Azure)

• Are interested in learning AI / LLM APIs

• Are fluent in English (written and spoken), as this is our corporate language. Danish is not a requirement.

• Hold a permit allowing you to live and work onsite in Denmark.

Not meeting every single bullet above? We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't exactly match all the qualifications in the job description, we still encourage you to apply.

What you might love about us

We have a strong youth community with trainees, interns and student assistants. With more than 30 nationalities across 10 locations, you will step into a genuinely international, informal and social environment: the kind where people enjoy working together, not just working next to each other. In Ultrabulk, we are convinced that an optimal working environment requires an exceptional social atmosphere across all departments. We believe that work should be fun and rewarding on a personal level. Our mission to be ‘a partner you can trust’ shines through in our way of being colleagues by caring for one another and, in unison, do our utmost to reach our goals for the business. We believe that flexibility is fundamental in ensuring a balanced life.

Application

We would like you to start as soon as possible. If you would like to learn more about the position, please reach out to Harshit Tripathi, Head of Fleet Efficiency & Decarbonisation at harshit.tripathi@ultrabulk.com.

Ready to set sail on this exciting journey with us? We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as applications are evaluated continuously, and interviews will take place on an ongoing basis. The deadline for uploading your CV and application is 22 November 2026, but we will close the position once the ideal match for our team has been found. Only applications uploaded digitally will be taken into consideration; we do not accept applications sent via e-mail. Your application will be treated with confidentiality and our reply will be sent to the e-mail address you have registered in our recruitment system.

We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive recruitment experience for all candidates. If you have any specific needs, please let us know how we can assist.

**ORDERYOYO – Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer

**Remote

• Quarterly team gatherings in one of our global offices

Join OrderYOYO’s Data team to build the data pipelines and lakehouse that power executive reporting and merchant insights across our platform, and automate how we deliver finance data and AI-driven data products to the rest of the business.

You’ll own complex changes from technical design through release and production operation, working closely with the leadership team, Finance, Product and fellow engineers. Your work will improve the accuracy and reliability of our reporting, merchant insights and finance data, while reducing routine manual Finance work.

Our data platform runs in a Microsoft Azure cloud environment, and we’re moving it to Microsoft Fabric. We value transferable experience: strong Azure Databricks or Synapse engineers who can quickly develop deep Fabric expertise are encouraged to apply. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure architecture, BI or people-management position, and you’ll regularly design, code, troubleshoot and operate production data solutions.

**Role Mission

**Build and evolve OrderYOYO’s data platform into a single source of truth for executive reporting, merchant insights, finance automation and AI, leading the move to a modern Microsoft Fabric lakehouse. You’ll help strengthen the reliability and quality of our data in production while building AI into how we deliver data products and supporting our growing international restaurant platform.

**Core Responsibilities

**

• Design, build and operate production-grade data solutions in Microsoft Fabric across Lakehouse, Warehouse, notebooks, pipelines and related platform capabilities.

• Build and run production pipelines in Fabric, Python and PySpark that are tested and maintainable, not just notebooks.

• Design ingestion and transformation patterns that scale across multiple source systems, databases and business domains while controlling source impact, concurrency and platform cost.

• Manage Fabric capacity and cost, and retire redundant legacy layers.

• Lead migrations from legacy to modern platforms with metric parity, stakeholder sign-off, change control and safe decommissioning.

• Run the platform in production: monitoring, alerting, incident triage, root-cause analysis, data-quality checks, lineage and runbooks.

• Diagnose and resolve production issues across SQL, Spark, pipelines and semantic models, including performance degradation, data failures and capacity/resource constraints.

• Support and evolve governed semantic models and reusable metric definitions, working closely with analytics and business stakeholders to ensure performance, consistency and reliability.

• Build AI into the platform and our delivery: RAG, Azure OpenAI and agents, with prompt and version management.

• Deliver applied data science such as churn, recommendations, personalisation, fraud or risk models, and show the results.

• Work with executives, Finance, Product and engineering, and judge when to move fast, standardise, automate or hold.

**Must-have Requirements

**

• 8+ years of relevant data experience, including substantial recent hands-on data engineering or data-platform engineering responsibility in production environments.

• Demonstrated ability to independently take a data-engineering problem from requirements and technical design through implementation, production deployment, monitoring and ongoing operation.

• Deep hands-on Microsoft Fabric, or strong Synapse, Databricks or Delta experience with a clear path to Fabric.

• Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture and Delta-based data engineering, including partitioning, schema evolution, file optimisation and performance considerations.

• Expert SQL and T-SQL, including complex modelling and tuning.

• Production-grade Python or PySpark.

• Strong experience designing and implementing incremental data ingestion patterns, including approaches such as CDC, change tracking or watermarks, with reliable merge/upsert, replay and idempotent processing.

• Experience with analytical and semantic data modelling, ideally with Power BI/Fabric semantic models, including performance optimisation, governance and reusable business metrics.

• Working knowledge of Azure platform fundamentals including Azure SQL, ADLS/OneLake, Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC and Key Vault.

• A track record of leading a legacy-to-modern migration.

• Real, hands-on AI engineering beyond out-of-the-box Copilot.

• Concrete data science or ML models you delivered, with results.

**Strong-to-have Experience

**

• Strong Power BI/Fabric experience, including Direct Lake, DAX, semantic model performance tuning, incremental refresh and capacity considerations.

• Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform, Bicep or equivalent tooling.

• Data platform experience in SaaS, marketplace, fintech, payments, e-commerce or multi-region businesses.

**Who We Are

**At OrderYOYO, company culture comes first. We create a positive, inclusive environment where people are trusted to do their best work and take ownership of what they build. We look for engineers who take ownership, raise risks early, explain decisions clearly, collaborate respectfully and follow through on commitments.

Our values describe what that looks like day to day:

• Passion: Adaptable and positive in a fast-moving environment, proactive about improving how things work.

• Action: Leads by example and takes the initiative rather than waiting to be asked.

• Compassion: Supports colleagues and considers the impact of decisions on merchants and teammates.

• One Team: Communicates clearly in writing and in person, stays calm under pressure and shares information openly.

We help restaurants succeed online by providing branded websites, mobile apps and tailored marketing solutions, giving them full control of their business. By removing high commission fees charged by third-party platforms, we empower restaurants to grow sustainably.

**What We Offer

**

• A salary of up to £75,000 per year (or local equivalent).

• A remote role, with quarterly in-person gatherings at one of our global offices.

• Ownership of a business-critical data and AI platform.

• A collaborative, international engineering team.

Are you interested in corporate treasury and motivated by combining financial analysis with practical execution?

If so, this is your opportunity to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Student Assistant for Treasury and gain hands-on experience in an international, fast-growing biopharmaceutical company.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a motivated and structured Student Assistant to support our Head of Treasury.

As a Student Assistant in Treasury, you will support analysis, reporting, documentation, and recurring operational activities across the treasury function. You will work closely with the Head of Treasury and collaborate with colleagues across Finance and the wider organization.

The role offers broad exposure to how a centralized treasury function manages liquidity, financial risk, funding, reporting, and banking relationships. You will contribute to both day-to-day activities and projects, with responsibilities developing as your knowledge and experience grow.

You will join a small, specialized Treasury team characterized by close collaboration, high professional standards, and an informal working environment.

You will report to the Head of Treasury, based in Hellerup.

As our new Student Assistant, you will support the Head of Treasury with:

• Treasury policy: Preparing analyses, presentations, and documentation supporting treasury policies, investment strategy, and the Group’s approach to financial risk.

• Cash management: Supporting daily liquidity monitoring, cash positioning, cash pool activities, cash flow forecasting, working capital analysis, and monitoring of financial investments.

• Funding: Supporting analysis and documentation related to capital structure, bank funding, debt agreements, and convertible notes.

• Risk management: Monitoring Group foreign exchange exposures and supporting FX transactions for liquidity and risk management purposes.

• Treasury reporting: Preparing recurring reporting and explaining developments in treasury-related profit and loss and balance sheet items.

• Bank relationships: Supporting bank administration, documentation, and follow-up with the Group’s relationship banks.

• Projects and process improvement: Contributing to treasury projects, data analysis, process documentation, and automation initiatives.

Your Profile

You are currently enrolled in a relevant academic program within Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or a similar field, preferably at the end of your bachelor’s degree or beginning your master’s degree.

You are curious about treasury and financial markets, comfortable working with data, and able to structure, follow up on, and complete tasks. You take ownership of your work, ask questions when needed, and enjoy collaborating in a dynamic environment.

Furthermore, you have

• Strong analytical skills and a flair for numbers

• A structured approach and attention to detail

• Reliability and the ability to handle recurring deadlines

• Good communication and collaboration skills

• Curiosity, sound judgement, and willingness to learn

Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills are important. Experience with ERP systems, financial data, Power BI, Power Automate, or similar tools is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Ascendis Pharma uses Microsoft Dynamics 365 and continues to develop its financial systems and processes. You should therefore be interested in learning new tools and contributing to more efficient, data-driven ways of working.

Also, you are proficient in English, both written and spoken.

Work hours: Approx. 15-20 hours a week. We want you to be able to balance your studies and work responsibilities and therefore offer flexibility during exam periods.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the company please visit our website www.ascendispharma.com.

All applications must be submitted in English and are treated confidentially.

jobs.occupation: Sales & Business Development Director – Defence & Maritime Security
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY

Saildrone is a maritime defense company and the global leader in autonomous unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). With more ocean miles and real-world operational experience than any USV manufacturer or operator, Saildrone maintains active, combat-deployed systems supporting national security and force projection around the world, 24/7/365.

Saildrone’s manufacturing and R&D headquarters are located in Alameda, CA, with business development and sales operations in Washington, DC, an established European entity supporting regional business development, sales, and operations, and a deployment hub in the Middle East. By combining proven autonomous operations, edge computing, advanced sensing, renewable power, and the most advanced and robust unmanned surface technology on the planet, Saildrone is shaping how the Navy of the future operates. Join a fast-moving, mission-driven team at the forefront of maritime security and autonomous innovation.

THE POSITION

The Sales & Business Development Manager will be responsible for identifying, developing, shaping, and capturing business opportunities across defence, maritime security, intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance, maritime domain awareness, and hydrographic sectors.

The successful candidate will establish and maintain relationships with defence and government stakeholders, military end users, procurement organizations, defence industry partners, maritime agencies, and commercial customers while driving the adoption of Saildrone's autonomous maritime solutions and services.

While the primary responsibility will be Germany, the role will also support selected strategic opportunities across Eastern Europe.

As Saildrone expands its Fleet of autonomous vessels, commercial activities, customer engagements, and operational footprint the successful candidate will be expected to assume a leadership role in building and growing the demand and European infrastructure for Saildrone’s next generation platform helping establish the foundation for long-term growth in one of Saildrone's most important international markets.

The ideal candidate will combine strong defence sales experience, deep knowledge of the German and European defence ecosystem, an understanding of government and political processes, and the ability to build trusted relationships with senior military, government, and industry leaders.

THE TEAM

The European Sales & Business Development team at Saildrone Europe is responsible for driving the company's growth and market expansion across Europe and selected international markets. The team works closely with government agencies, defence organizations, maritime security stakeholders, research institutions, and commercial customers to identify opportunities, develop strategic partnerships, and deliver innovative maritime domain awareness, Bathymetry, and Meteorology and Oceanography solutions. Through customer engagement, market analysis, proposal development, contract negotiations, and cross-functional collaboration with product, engineering, operations, and executive leadership, the team helps shape Saildrone's regional strategy and ensures customers realize the full value of Saildrone's autonomous maritime technologies. Our mission is to strengthen maritime security, enhance situational awareness, and support data-driven decision-making through persistent, autonomous ocean intelligence.

THE RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and execute Saildrone's sales and business development strategy across Germany and Selected Eastern European Countries.

• Identify, qualify, shape, and capture opportunities for Saildrone's autonomous maritime solutions and associated data services.

• Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline that supports ambitious revenue growth objectives.

• Lead customer engagements from opportunity identification through contract award and execution.

• Develop account strategies and long-term customer engagement plans.

• Achieve annual sales targets and contribute to Saildrone's regional growth objectives.

• Support proposal development, contract negotiations, commercial discussions, and bid submissions.

• Act as a subjected matter expert of our next generation platform

• Establish and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders

• Develop a detailed understanding of customer requirements, capability priorities, and future acquisition programs.

• Represent Saildrone at military exercises, trials, demonstrations, conferences, and industry events.

• Support customer operational evaluations and capability demonstrations

• Build relationships with UK and international defence primes, shipbuilders, system integrators, and maritime technology providers.

• Support industrial cooperation, offset, and localization discussions where appropriate

THE QUALIFICATIONS

• Minimum 8 years of experience in defence, maritime, aerospace, security, or government sales.

• Proven track record of winning and growing complex defence and government business opportunities.

• Strong commercial sales background with responsibility for customer relationships, revenue generation, and business growth.

• Extensive knowledge of the German and European defence acquisition and procurement environment.

• Strong understanding of Germanys governmental and political processes influencing defence spending and capability development.

• Established network across Germanys defence, maritime, and security sectors.

• Experience in engaging with senior military officers, government officials, and industry executives.

• Excellent presentation, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a geographically dispersed team.

• Willingness to travel extensively throughout Germany and Europe,

• Eligibility to obtain and maintain Security Clearance in Germany.

Saildrone offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits tailored to each global region. Please note that specific benefits listed below may vary or be adapted for roles based in Denmark in accordance with local labor standards and Danish market practices.

To view Saildrone's candidate privacy policy, please visit: https://www.saildrone.com/privacy-policy.

BENEFITS

At Saildrone, we’re building operational capability that matters—and that requires people who can do their best work over the long term. We invest in our team’s well-being, financial security, and professional growth so you can focus on delivering real-world impact with confidence and stability. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support you and your family while you contribute to a mission with lasting significance.

**The Role

**You will own and lead global communication strategy for our Urology business area, playing a central role in Ambu’s transformation toward more insight-driven, digitally fluent, and customer-centric marketing. Based at our headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark, you will work closely with other Global MarCom Managers, our Brand & Creation team, Digital Marketing Specialists, Global Product Managers, Medical Affairs, and local sales companies to develop customer-centric, insight-driven, and commercially impactful communication. Your primary team consists of downstream product managers and you will work together on the daily to drive the Urology business forward.

Drive commercial marketing and business impact You will develop and optimize communication throughout the customer journey and your ability to seek out insights, interpret limited data, and translate findings into impactful communication will be essential to our success. From ideation to execution, you’ll ensure alignment, consistency, and commercial impact throughout the customer journey.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Own and lead the development and execution of global communication strategy for Urology, with a strong drive to build data-based customer communication.

• Developing sales enablement materials and content that empower commercial teams and drive engagement with healthcare professionals.

• Collaborating closely with the Digital Marketing team to identify performance and adapt communications accordingly.

• Collaborate with the Brand and Creative team to deliver sales & marketing materials that are both on-brand and commercially effective.

**Commercial mindset, proactive and collaborative

**You are a data-driven, commercially minded marketer, motivated by the challenge of building this capability in a less mature environment. You understand customer journeys and develop communication strategies that optimize business impact, even when insights are limited. You are resourceful, curious, and proactive in seeking out insights, and you can turn even small data points into meaningful communication. You enjoy collaborating with others and are eager to help shape our data-driven future. You’re skilled at managing stakeholders and building alignment across global teams.

To succeed, you’ll need: **Skills

**_Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you have:

_

• A Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field

• 10+ years of experience in commercial marketing, acquired in corporate roles, agencies, or both.

• Proven commercial experience within MedTech or Pharma.

• A proven ability to connect marketing to business results through communication & channel strategy, and sales enablement.

• Driven, hands-on, and strong sense of ownership.

• Strong project leadership skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across time zones and functions.

• A proactive mindset with the ability to drive transformation in how we engage HCPs and stakeholders

• Excellent communication skills in English (verbal and written)

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is on an ambitious growth journey, expanding globally and pushing the boundaries of innovation in healthcare. Here, your contributions will directly shape our success. You’ll work in an international head office with a collaborative, open culture—where ideas matter, and impact is visible. We offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits along with exciting job challenges and career opportunities contributing to your job satisfaction.

**When to apply

**If you are ready to apply for the position, please apply. Your application will be treated confidentially.

💰 **Salary, based on experience level:

**🇬🇧 London - up to £92 000 a year/gross

🇩🇰 Copenhagen - up to 74 000 DKK a month/gross

**Intro

**Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We're looking for a Solution Engineer who's ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us — through the grind and the wins. You'll be the technical partner to our Sales team: you work out what customers need, show them how Monta solves it, and make sure what we sell can be delivered.

**This Is What You Will Achieve

**

• Win the technical decision — be the reason charge point operators, energy companies and fleet owners choose Monta to run their charging business.

• Make sure what we sell gets delivered — the commitments made during the sale are realistic and land cleanly with our implementation team.

• Shape the product — turn what you hear from customers into clear input that Product and Engineering can act on.

**What You Will Do

**

• Lead technical discovery — understand the customer's business, their current charging setup (platform, hardware, roaming, billing) and what they need to integrate with.

• Run demos built around the customer — tailored to their use cases, not a feature tour.

• Design the solution — define the high-level architecture and integration approach, from OCPP chargers and OCPI roaming to APIs, ERP and energy management.

• Lead proofs of concept and technical evaluations — agree scope and success criteria up front and see them through to sign-off.

• Answer the hard questions — technical, architecture, integration and security questions in meetings, RFPs and security questionnaires.

• Spot risk early — flag gaps and dependencies before a deal is committed, and push back when a promise can't be kept.

• Partner with Sales — on the technical strategy for complex, multi-country deals.

• Hand over cleanly — give the Solution Architect a documented scope so implementation starts on solid ground.

• Close the loop with Product — feed recurring requirements and product gaps back to Product and Engineering.

• Help post-sales when it's busy — for example scoping a migration or running a technical workshop with a live customer.

**What We're Looking For

**

• Experience in a customer-facing technical role — as a Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer or pre-sales consultant, selling B2B software or platform products.

• You explain technical topics clearly to non-technical people — and can go deep with the customer's engineers in the same meeting.

• Your discovery gets to the real problem — you ask the question behind the requirement before proposing a solution.

• You build demos that tell the customer's story — you're comfortable changing course live when the conversation goes somewhere new.

• Hands-on with APIs and integrations — you can read API docs, test calls yourself, and explain web-hooks, authentication and data flows.

• Commercial awareness — you understand how deals are won and lost, and you know when to protect scope.

• You write clearly — solution designs, RFP answers and handover notes that others can act on without a follow-up call.

• EV charging, energy or mobility knowledge is a plus (OCPP, OCPI, load management), but not required. We'll teach you the domain.

• You use AI to work faster — for example on RFP drafts, research, demo prep and documentation, and you check the output before it reaches a customer.

• Fluent English, and happy to travel to customer workshops around Europe from time to time.

**_If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway — we care about potential, not perfection.

_****Why Monta

**

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you'll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don't micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

**What We Offer

**

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

jobs.occupation: Data Portfolio Analyst, Markets Data Office
jobs.description:
_Recently graduated or one to two years into your career? Join us and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now.

__Join us in building a new data capability in Markets

**About The Job

**At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets.

We are a newly established team and still in our build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve.

As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets.

This is an opportunity to join early, learn quickly and help shape how we work.

**What You Will Do

**As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will work within one of our four domain areas together with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams. Your focus will be on improving how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled.

Depending on your domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market data, price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data.

You will learn about Markets from experienced colleagues and gradually take responsibility for your own tasks. At the same time, you will be part of one Markets Data Office with shared standards, tooling and governance practices.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Helping identify and document Critical Data Attributes (CDAs) by reviewing data points with stakeholders and assessing which are critical for Saxo

• Analysing data together with data owners to assess quality, identify issues and contribute to root cause investigations

• Helping define and maintain data definitions, rules, thresholds and supporting documentation

• Monitoring data quality outputs, following up on remediation and raising issues when they are not being resolved

• Collaborating with data owners, data stewards and stakeholders across business and technology

• Contributing to the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office

A key part of your role will be making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain. This helps create transparency and consistency across the organisation.

**Who You Are

**You have recently graduated or have around one to two years of professional experience.

**We Imagine That You Bring

**

• A relevant degree in finance, economics, business analytics, information systems, data science or a similar field

• An interest in data and how it is used in business processes

• Experience with SQL, Python or similar tools from your studies, a student job or projects

• Hands on experience using AI and other technology tools to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working

• Good communication skills in English and the ability to write clear and structured documentation

**It would be an advantage if you have

**

• Experience from banking or financial services, for example through a student job

• Knowledge of, or an interest in, Markets functions such as trading, risk, investment products or operations, including how a trade moves from front to back

• Exposure to data governance or data quality work such as data profiling, data controls or data lineage, ideally within financial services

• Familiarity with Databricks, Great Expectations, OpenMetadata or similar tools

Just as important as your experience is how you approach your work.

**We Are Looking For Someone Who

**

• Takes ownership. You move your work forward, follow through and take initiative.

• Collaborates naturally. You build relationships with business stakeholders, technology teams and colleagues across different domain areas.

• Uses technology naturally. You use technology to analyse, automate, document and find more effective ways of working.

• Is comfortable working in an evolving environment. You adapt as priorities develop, bring structure to areas that are still taking shape and contribute to building solutions together with the team.

• Is structured and curious. You have a strong analytical mindset, pay attention to detail and enjoy understanding how things work.

jobs.occupation: Management Consultants in Supply Chain Planning – Graduates 2027
jobs.description:
**Job description

**We're looking for talented and curious graduates who want to start a career in management consulting at the intersection of deep functional expertise and digital planning solutions.

**What you’ll do

**In this role, you’ll be joining a nerdy team that designs and delivers optimal supply chains by combining best-in-class processes with leading digital solutions. Every day, we help clients transform their planning processes in demand, supply, and inventory optimisation across the value chain and planning horizons.

You’ll be working on a wide range of projects. Depending on your personal journey and development goals, your role in a project could include:

• 
**Design and implement planning excellence

**: Apply advanced concepts in forecasting, demand and supply planning, S&OP/IBP, inventory optimisation, and operational planning to build robust, end‑to‑end planning processes.

• 
**Enable adoption and capability building

**: Train stakeholders and facilitate client workshops to co-create designs, refine processes, and embed continuous improvement.

• 
**Translate requirements into actionable processes

**: Convert business needs into well-defined process designs and implementation plans – with clear governance, data, and decision flows.

• 
**Guide digital planning transformations

**: Advise clients on solution architecture and roadmaps for SAP IBP and other leading platforms from concept to configuration and adoption.

• 
**Deliver measurable impact

**: Execute projects that optimise planning tools and processes, strengthen performance management, and build organisational capabilities that sustain excellence.

If this sounds like the kind of nerdery you would like to dive deep into, you’ll feel right at home in our team.

Please note this role is based in our **Copenhagen

**office.

**What you’ll bring

**As our new team member, you’ll be working at the forefront of supply chain transformation – integrating digital enablers with core business functions to create end-to-end impact, from strategy and design to implementation and adoption.

To be a great fit, you hold – or are about to complete – a master's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, supply chain, operations research, or business analytics, with strong academic results to show for it.

On top of that, we’re looking for someone who meets most of the following criteria:

• 
**Relevant experience

**: Ideally, you’ve applied supply chain concepts through an internship, student role, or thesis project.

• 
**Project-driven and adaptable

**: You enjoy working in a project-based setting, managing timelines, stakeholders, and changing priorities.

• 
**Interest in digital tools

**: Ideally, you have exposure to SAP (e.g., SAP IBP) or other digital planning platforms or you are interested in building expertise in digital planning solutions.

• 
**Analytical problem-solver

**: You love turning complex problems into clear insights and actionable solutions.

• 
**Structured communicator

**: You can structure and deliver compelling presentations and workshops in English (proficiency in another European language is a plus, but not a requirement).

Supply chains are becoming one of the most strategically important – and technically complex – areas in business. If you want to be at the sharp end of that, join our team where curiosity is rewarded, diverse perspectives are valued, and where you will make an impact from day one.

**What we offer

**At Implement, a healthy, dynamic, and collaborative environment always comes first. You'll become part of a fast-growing, entrepreneurial Scandinavian consultancy that gives you the space to grow, lead, and innovate while creating real results for our clients.

• 
**Build deep functional expertise

**: develop mastery across demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimisation, S&OP/IBP, and digital planning tools with ownership of end-to-end planning transformations.

• 
**Hands-on from day one

**: work on client projects immediately, side by side with experienced consultants who elevate your strategic thinking and methodological rigour.

• 
**Continuous development

**: get access to an ambitious internal training programme with keynotes, workshops, certifications, and mentoring to accelerate your professional and personal growth.

• 
**High-trust culture

**: enjoy autonomy, support, and a flat hierarchy in a team that shares knowledge freely and continuously raises its standards.

• 
**International environment

**: work on planning transformation projects for global clients, collaborating across cultures, industries, and markets on programmes that deliver measurable impact.

Make your next move matter.

**How to apply

**Please include your CV, a cover letter, and your GPA for both your BSc and MSc.

Start date for this position is flexible, either winter 2026/2027 or September/October 2027.

**About Implement

**Implement Consulting Group (founded 1996) is an international management consulting firm with 1,900+ employees. Headquartered in Copenhagen, we have 12 offices across the Nordics, the DACH region, and the United States, making us one of the largest European consultancies. We support organisations in delivering sustainable strategic, commercial, and operational transformations. To help our clients succeed with their most critical change initiatives, we aim to attract, develop, and promote the best talent by creating a unique, collaborative learning environment where people can follow their passion, shape their own careers, and choose their own leaders.

Are you an experienced product management leader who thrives in complex, international environments and enjoys turning category strategy into action? Do you have a passion for building high-performing teams, driving organisational change, and creating clarity across a diverse portfolio of products and brands? Then this Senior Director, Global Product Management might spark your interest.

Shape the future of global diagnostics product management

We are looking for a Senior Director, Global Product Management to lead and further develop our Global Product Management function within Demant Diagnostics. In this role, you will set the strategic direction for our product categories, strengthen category management capabilities across the organisation, and play a key role in shaping the future of a business undergoing significant transformation.

The role reports to Jacob Torpe Winter, Head of Global Strategic Marketing, and is based at our Diagnostics headquarters in Smørum, Copenhagen, with the opportunity to work from home when tasks allow.

Make a visible impact on a growing global business

As Senior Director, Global Product Management, you will lead a team of category managers and be responsible for building a best-in-class product management organisation across our diagnostics portfolio. You will ensure that category strategies, product roadmaps, and brand positioning support our long-term growth ambitions while creating alignment across brands, functions, and geographies.

The role combines strategic leadership, organisational development, stakeholder management, and change leadership. You will work closely with leaders across our global brands, Global Strategic Marketing, R&D, and Operations to establish strong ways of working and deliver greater strategic focus across the portfolio.

Join a business in transformation

Demant Diagnostics is a global provider of diagnostic solutions within hearing and balance assessment. As part of an evolving organisation, we are strengthening our global product management capabilities and creating a more structured and data-driven approach to category management.

This role offers a unique opportunity to influence both the future of our product portfolio and the way we work as an organisation. You will join a highly collaborative leadership environment where your experience, perspective, and leadership will help drive meaningful change across the business.

Lead strategy, people and transformation

Your key responsibilities include:

• Define and execute the global category management strategy across the Diagnostics portfolio aligned with the Diagnostics multi brand strategy.

• Lead, coach, and develop the team and global product management organization

• Establish effective ways of working, governance, and collaboration across brands and functions.

• Drive category-level strategies and category-level initiatives, product roadmaps, and lifecycle management plans across multiple brands ensuring adoption of strategic priorities.

• Partner with brands, R&D, Commercial Excellence, and Operations leadership to translate customer needs into portfolio decisions.

• Lead organisational change initiatives and ensure adoption of strategic priorities across stakeholders.

• Build strong relationships with senior leaders, customers, and key industry stakeholders.

You Are An Experienced Product Management Leader

Success in this role requires a strong combination of strategic thinking, commercial acumen, leadership capability, and change management experience. You are comfortable navigating complexity, influencing senior stakeholders, and creating alignment in a matrix organisation.

We imagine that you have:

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, marketing, engineering, or a related discipline combines with extensive experience with product & category management.

• A proven track record of leading high-performing teams and organisational change while delivering sustainable business transformation

• Solid experience from a global MedTech, Life Sciences, healthcare, diagnostics, or similarly complex B2B environment. Experience with audiology or diagnostics products is highly desirable.

• Strong commercial understanding and an ability to translate market insights into strategic decisions

• Experience leading senior specialists or leaders within a matrix organisation

• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills

The ideal candidate has built their career within product management and understands how to combine strategic direction with practical execution. You are a confident and approachable leader who knows how to challenge constructively, develop people, and create followership through credibility, collaboration, and clear communication. You bring humility, curiosity, and a genuine interest in helping others succeed while driving ambitious change.

Want to join the team?

If you are motivated by the opportunity to lead a strategically important function, develop a high-performing team, and help shape the future of Demant Diagnostics, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your application no later than 18th of November. Please note we only accept applications submitted via our application system in accordance with the GDPR legislation.

• We aim to conduct 1st round of interviews on Monday the 20th of November

• We aim to conduct 2nd round of interviews on Thursday the 26th of November

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

About Demant Diagnostics

Demant’s diagnostics business is a trusted diagnostic solutions provider in the field of hearing and balance assessment. This group of international companies develops, manufactures, and markets a wide variety of technological solutions globally, delivering instruments, software, training, and services that support the entire diagnostic journey – from early screening to advanced clinical assessment and balance treatment. Our portfolio includes well-known brands such as Maico, Interacoustics, E3, Amplivox, GSI Grason-Stadler, MedRx, Audioscan, and Inventis.

Our products are sold in more than 100 countries through an extensive network of sales companies and distributors.

For more information, please visit: www.demant.com.

• Printing Batch Process Records and managing manufacturing labels.

• Providing real-time review of manufacturing records and logbooks.

Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Behind every success is a team of dedicated experts driving us forward. Our corporate functions don’t just support — they lead, shaping the company’s path and preparing clients and employees for the moments that matter. Be part of a team where your work makes a difference, with opportunities to grow, collaborate, and thrive.

There is. It's Light.

Light is building an AI-native financial platform for modern companies. Fast to implement, intuitive to use, and designed to get smarter over time. We call it organic software.

Companies like Legora, Lovable, and Fuse Energy already run on Light. Following our $30M Series A last year, we're building the team that will make Light the default finance platform for the next generation of businesses.

**Why DACH, why now.

**To win Europe, you have to win DACH. We know this. That's why we're making our first dedicated hire for the region and treating it as a must-win market. You won't be a satellite of a global team running templated playbooks. You'll be a builder. The person who decides what Light looks and feels like in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

**What You'll Be Doing.

**

• Building Light's presence in DACH from the ground up, shaping our GTM strategy, and becoming one of the defining faces of the region. If you'd rather set the direction than follow it, this is your gig.

**

**The good stuff.

💸 Competitive salary.

🏝 25 days annual leave plus public holidays in your country of employment.

🚀 The chance to shape a category from the inside, not just market around it.

🌍 Regular travel to Copenhagen, London, New York, and wherever the action is.

At Verifi, you will become part of a dedicated and highly skilled team that values knowledge sharing, development, and collaboration. We foster a work environment where professional growth and learning are prioritised—whether through certifications or by drawing on the experience of your colleagues.

You will primarily work from our office by Østerbro as well as from your home office. We take a flexible approach to work-life balance and respect your personal circumstances—whether you are part of a young family or have other commitments.

Most of our employees work in small teams, delivering projects for one or more clients. Our deliveries are managed by a project manager or delivery manager, ensuring clear agreements and a structured workflow so you can focus on your tasks.

At Verifi, we believe that a workplace should be more than just a job. We value community and prioritise social activities such as Data Saturday, foraging trips in Grib Skov, or simply sharing a glass of wine before the holidays.

Does this sound like the right fit for you? We look forward to hearing from you!

Vacancies at Verifi

Microsoft backend developer

Are you passionate about customer-specific BI solutions that make a difference? Do you want to develop in collaboration with skilled colleagues and ambitious clients? Then Verifi might be the place for you! Verifi is growing, and we would like to welcome more backend BI developers on board.

Application

Interested? Send a short letter of motivation and your CV to: ktm@verifi.dk, noting “BI Consultant” in the subject line. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and would like to receive your application as soon as possible.

We encourage everyone to apply regardless of age, gender, religion, or ethnic background.

Applications are processed continuously.

Core Tasks

• Development of data warehouse solutions with Microsoft Technology

• Analysis and design of data warehouse solutions and platforms in collaboration with the client and our other participants

• Breakdown, estimation, and planning of complex data warehouse projects

• Participation in other project activities, including internal testing and client testing/UAT

Are you familiar with the following:

• The Microsoft Fabric platform

• Azure SQL Database and other Azure storage technologies

• Data Factory, Azure Functions, and other transformation and orchestration tools in Azure

• T-SQL

• Tabular models

• Integration via APIs, such as REST API

• A structured and risk-minimising approach to development tasks

• An analytical mindset and a fact-based approach to problem-solving

• Good communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders in both Danish and English

We place great emphasis on you having several years of hands-on project experience with a number of the technologies mentioned.

**Join us to Make an Impact

**Innovation is in our DNA. We invented supercontinuum lasers and photonic crystal fibers and we constantly reimagine how our products can be used and improved. Our customers use our products in medical and life science research, quantum computing and space exploration.

We seek curious, creative and collaborative people to work in our cutting-edge company. Can you see yourself working in teams and providing solutions for innovators?

If you wish to apply, please contact us with your CV / Résumé. If you have a cover letter, please save this in one document with your CV / Résumé as you are only able to upload one document.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Join Our Team as **Student Assistant - Procurement

**Put your studies into practice as a Student Assistant in our Procurement team. Gain hands-on experience with data analysis, suppliers, and procurement processes while supporting an international organization.

**Your Role And Responsibilities

**

• Procurement excellence: Support improvements to procurement processes, procedures, templates, workflows, and reporting.

• Indirect procurement: Support sourcing activities by collecting quotations, comparing offers, and following up with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

• Data and insights: Prepare reports, analyse data, and identify spending patterns, data gaps, and improvement opportunities.

• Procurement master data: Collect, maintain, and validate supplier, contract, and purchasing data, including questionnaires, certificates, and supplier records.

• Team support: Assist the Procurement team with supplier documentation, follow-up activities, and other operational tasks as needed.

**What You Bring To The Team

**

• Relevant studies: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree within supply chain, business, economics, or a related field.

• Analytical mindset: Comfortable working with data and turning it into useful insights.

• Digital skills: Comfortable with Excel and interested in developing Power BI skills. ERP experience is an advantage.

• Working style: Proactive, curious, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating with others.

• Communication: Confident written and spoken English

**What You Will Gain

**Develop your analytical and coordination skills alongside experienced colleagues. Gain practical procurement and supplier experience in an international environment - a strong foundation for your future career.

**Keep your personal data safe

**Hamamatsu ("The Company") take responsibly for the protection of your personal data. Accordingly, upon receiving your job application and additional material you choose to submit, the Company keeps a safe and secure environment and ensures confidentiality.

You also have a role to play in keeping your personal data safe. We request you only submit personal data about yourself in your job application, CV / Résumé or other relevant material you choose to provide to us that is relevant for the specific job opening you are applying for.

Please consider whether there is personal information you are about to submit, such as health information, information on family relations, information on trade union membership, etc. that is not necessary for our recruitment process or the job opening you are applying for. Please also be aware that certificates or other documents are not necessary for the vacancy. We urgently request you to redact/cross out such information before you submit your job application.

Thank you.

jobs.occupation: VIKING is looking for a Student Assistant for our Legal team
jobs.description:
JOIN VIKING - and become a lifesaver
Are you looking for that perfect place to provide you with the challenges you need to build your skills and reach your potential? Are you looking forward to working in a company with a clear purpose of saving lives and having ambitious goals for the foreseeable future?

If you can say yes to the above then it might be you we are looking for as our Student Assistant in our Legal team. We have a great opportunity within the area of maritime regulatory affairs and International legislation, hereunder sanctions and corporate legal documents. You may also be asked to contribute to work related to GDPR, Sustainability, ESG, business and IT law as a part of our legal team. 

At VIKING, we live by saving lives. We are proud to be a world leading supplier of safety products, solutions, and services to the global maritime industry. shore platforms, ferries, fishing vessels, and superyachts.

Safety is the core in everything we do and our mission to protect and save human lives.

What you’ll be doing 

We are looking for a dedicated student assistant to be an active member of our Legal team. You will need a problem-solving mindset because no day will be the same.

Working closely with your experienced colleagues, you will have a key role planning, coordinating and executing tasks relating to corporate legal functions and supporting Regulatory Affairs. For example, you will be responsible for coordinating various internal and extern fora relevant for our business and supporting our many internal stakeholders with legal material.

Your skills and efforts will be key to successfully:

• Planning, coordinating and executing tasks relating to the legal department and compliance
• Analyse, develop, implement and maintain new legislation, internal processes and policies, locally and globally
• Creation and implementation of local guidelines and on-going re-evaluation of these
• Support to Regulatory Affairs on Intellectual Properties Rights and administration of patents
• Support in legal risk management and sustainability management 
• Navigate in a global organization with many stakeholders and assist them on an ongoing basis
• provide ad-hoc practical and administrative support to your colleagues
You’ll work approximately 15 hours per week, with flexibility to adjust to your personal life  – with favourable flexibility around exam periods.

Become a part of VIKING

Student assistants play an important role within the VIKING organisation. Many of our students also complete their internships with us and write their thesis about real-world projects and challenges at VIKING.

When you start your career with us, you will become part of our strong Young VIKING Network which brings together over 40 ambitious trainees, graduates and student assistants. This community is designed to boost personal and professional development including opportunities to participate in social events. Learn more about our Young VIKING Network here.

What we’re looking for 

You are currently studying your BA.jur., or have at least 1.5 years left of cand.jur. 

You are driven and looking for exactly that company which can offer you a student job and later a permanent position in our Legal Division. 

• Good communication skills and can convey complex legal topics clearly
• Good collaboration skills and ability to navigate in a global Company
• The ability to work independently and make well-considered decisions
• A methodical and structured approach to your tasks and natural sense of details
• Fluent Danish and English skills, both orally and in writing

VIKING offers

We offer a rewarding position that provides opportunities for personal and professional growth in collaboration with colleagues, who value humour, job satisfaction, and a great work environment.

VIKING is a global workplace where the majority of our activities address the whole world. We have a strong culture and give space to the individual – we know everyone brings a unique contribution. That’s why we invest in our employees and offer unique career opportunities in an international organization.

We also offer:

• A strong commitment to well-being and work-life balance
• Good health insurance coverage
• Special discounts in local shops
• An active employee association that arranges various social events
Do you want to be a part of VIKING?

All applications are received online by “Send application” in the job add. We conduct interviews continuously and therefore recommend you send your application and resume as soon as possible. All applications are naturally handled with confidentiality.

Start date is as soon as possible, however we don’t mind waiting for the right candidate.

If you have questions concerning the position or VIKING, you are welcome to reach out to HR Business Partner Søren Langelund on phone +45 2542 8240 or by e-mail SL@viking-life.com.

Read more at www.viking-life.com

JOIN VIKING - YOUR CAREER IS SAFE WITH US

Building keeps getting cheaper every quarter. What used to take a senior engineer a few weeks now takes an afternoon. The work that does not get cheaper is helping a real business absorb new technology, sequencing the rollout, and knowing when to slow down because something is starting to break under load.

At Heyra, we build operational AI: systems, workflows, and data platforms that live in production from day one. We work with companies that are moving quickly and need solutions that improve the way they operate.

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer. Someone who goes into a client, understands the operation, spots where the real optimisation potential sits, and pushes it all the way through to execution with a strong engineering team behind them.

The role sits between engineering and consulting without fitting cleanly into either. You need to be technical enough to understand data and AI at a deep level. Commercial enough to spot where the business value sits. Patient enough to sit with a manager who is genuinely worried about the tool you just put in front of them. And stubborn enough to stay around once the launch excitement fades and the real adoption work begins.

Most people are strong in one of those. Some in two. Almost nobody walks in with all four. That is exactly the profile we are looking for.

What you will work on

You will embed directly with clients to understand the operation and where the real value sits. You will drive adoption by sequencing rollouts, working with the people who have to use the tool, and staying through the unglamorous part. You will translate business needs into AI solutions that actually ship. And you will learn when to push, when to slow down, and when something is starting to break under load.

You work closely with engineers, data specialists, strategists, and designers in a company where the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

**Requirements

**Experience with management consulting, change management, or adoption of AI solutions in production. An understanding of software development, ML or data engineering. Familiarity with AI and GenAI frameworks, possibly with some MLOps and evals exposure. Experience with cloud environments like Azure or GCP.

Coding with agents like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. Working directly with clients and stakeholders. Owning delivery end to end, from a vague problem to a live, adopted solution.

Curiosity, taste and a builder mentality matter just as much to us as specific tools or years of experience.

Why Heyra

We believe consulting needs to be rewritten. We are building a consultancy designed for the agentic era. We design, build and operate AI products that change how enterprises work, from problem to prototype to production.

Heyra brings together people from engineering, strategy, product, startup and creative environments. We keep teams small, collaboration close and momentum high. We care deeply about craft, speed and building things that work in the real world.

People here care about what they build. Good ideas move quickly. New technology gets explored early. There is room to shape both the company and the way we work.

We are around 45 people today, and we are only just getting started.

If this sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

**Benefits

**

• Healthcare insurance

• Pension plan

• Parental leave

• Social gatherings

• New tech gear

• Central office

• Free lunch, coffee, snacks, and Friday beers

• Skill development

• Paid holiday

• Remote work allowed

• Pet friendly
